preferences.name: composeFile
preferences.title: Compose File
preferences.description: The Docker Compose file whose bind mounts under /workspaces give the devcontainer path of a file. Empty turns off the devcontainer path.

preferences.name: sessionContainers
preferences.title: Session Containers
preferences.description: The Docker containers whose agent sessions to show, separated by commas. name=label sets the label that the list shows.

preferences.name: sessionUser
preferences.title: Container User
preferences.description: The user that runs the agents in the containers. Empty uses the default user of the container.

preferences.name: sessionDays
preferences.title: Session Days
preferences.description: Show the sessions whose log changed in the last number of days. 0 shows all sessions.

preferences.name: sessionName
preferences.title: Session Name
preferences.description: Which text names a session in the list and on the clipboard. A set name is one that you gave with /rename or /name, a cmux title that of the cmux terminal where the agent runs now, and an agent title one that the agent made. The README lists the source for each agent. A session without such a text is not in the list.
